stories.title: US launches new strikes on Iran, revokes oil sales permit after 3 ships attacked in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: The US carried out strikes on Iran overnight and revoked an oil-export sales permit after three ships were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating tensions over shipping through the key oil lane.

stories.title: Japan raises residency fee for foreign nationals by twenty-fold
stories.summary: Japan hiked the residency fee for foreign nationals twenty-fold as part of immigration-policy changes aimed at managing its growing foreign population.

stories.title: Salesforce acquires AI customer research company Listen Labs
stories.summary: Salesforce bought Listen Labs, an AI customer research company that is its sixth AI-focused acquisition this year, in a deal expected to close in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027.

stories.title: Jeffries pans Trump AI agreement as 'entirely unenforceable'
stories.summary: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries called the White House's voluntary AI agreement 'entirely unenforceable,' citing rogue-agent incidents and pressing Congress to legislate AI rules now rather than later.

stories.title: OSWorld-Science: new benchmark for AI agents operating scientific software
stories.summary: A new arXiv benchmark evaluates how computer-use AI agents handle scientific software, finding even top vision-language models succeed only around 70% of the time on average and about 40% on the hardest tasks, a sign scientific automation is still far off.

stories.title: GrammarRL: reinforcement learning for grammar-constrained LLM output
stories.summary: A new arXiv paper introduces GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement-learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without annotated data, aiming for more reliable structured output.

stories.title: Browns vs. Steelers Thursday Night Football prediction, picks and odds
stories.summary: Preview of Thursday's Browns-Steelers game at Huntington Bank Field, with Covers picking Pittsburgh and pointing to the Aaron Rodgers-to-Roman Wilson connection as a key storyline.

stories.title: Steelers vs. Browns predictions, picks and odds for Thursday night
stories.summary: The Athletic breaks down tonight's AFC North matchup, with the Steelers road favorites over the Browns in a game where every division team enters at 2-1.

stories.title: Ohio State availability report: how is Buckeyes' health heading to Iowa
stories.summary: Ohio State released its availability report ahead of Saturday's road game at Iowa, laying out the Buckeyes' injury situation and game-time decisions before the Big Ten matchup.

stories.title: Verstappen adds Portimao GT3 race in the middle of hectic F1 schedule
stories.summary: Max Verstappen will race a Mercedes-AMG GT3 at the GT World Challenge Europe finale at Portimao in October, his first GTWC outing and the first time he'll share the grid with MotoGP legend Valentino Rossi.

stories.title: Hamilton strongly backs Vasseur amid Horner to Ferrari links
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton publicly backed Ferrari team principal Fred Vasseur amid renewed rumors about his future, calling Vasseur the guy to take the team forward and voicing frustration at the negativity around the team.

stories.title: Audi confirms plans for new F1 base
stories.summary: Audi's Formula 1 team confirmed plans for a new campus near its factory in Hinwil, Switzerland, with early elements already operational in summer 2026 and full completion targeted for 2030.

stories.title: Alonso renews F1 contract with Aston Martin
stories.summary: Fernando Alonso will race on into 2027, his 24th F1 season, after a quick contract renewal with Aston Martin that keeps him in the sport at age 46.

stories.title: Who is Patrick Havas, alleged attacker at Amy Acton campaign event
stories.summary: NBC4 compiled what's known about Patrick Havas, the man accused of attacking former Ohio health director Amy Acton at a campaign event, in the latest twist of her Senate race.

stories.title: Columbus man reverses plea in deadly road-rage shooting
stories.summary: A Columbus man who pleaded guilty in a deadly road-rage shooting retained new counsel and reversed his plea, reopening the case in Franklin County.

stories.title: Bexley to welcome dog-friendly outdoor expansion of The Lion
stories.summary: The Lion restaurant in Bexley is planning a dog-friendly outdoor expansion, adding new patio space for the Columbus-area eatery.
